papers.key_result: DUPLICATE of ledger 1300 (already deep-read 2026-09-21, ADAPT). 888 NBA lineups, 140 order-stat predictors, 7-model unanimous classifier: 13/15 = 86.7% elite precision. Replaced by 1499.
papers.title: Predicting Elite NBA Lineups Using Individual Player Order Statistics

papers.key_result: Linear CDF-pool combination optimized jointly on DRPS and inventory cost via NSGA-III; Pareto knee dominates single-objective weights. M5: 28,903 series (60.1% zeros), sequential train/val/test splits; RAF: 5,000 monthly series. Transfer: combine pick models on calibration AND bankroll utility simultaneously.
papers.title: Multi-objective probabilistic forecast combination for inventory demand

papers.key_result: 123-page ACL landing simulation thesis (OpenSim/SCONE/Moco). No injury-labeled cohort, no predictive validation; Moco effort weight 0->1 swings vGRF 1.967->11.479 BW. REJECT: simulation-only, no NFL transfer path. Replaced by 1498.
papers.title: ACL landing simulation thesis

papers.key_result: MA-PaPSP: training-free selective prediction via external VLM memory bank + retrieved proxy embeddings + contrastive score normalization. AURC reductions: MS-COCO 0.136->0.109, Flowers 0.074->0.063, UCF-101 0.113->0.088, SugarCrepe 0.078->0.062. Transfer: kNN memory-bank confidence gate / abstention layer over frozen pick models.
papers.title: Leveraging Data to Say No: Memory Augmented Plug-and-Play Selective Prediction

papers.key_result: Continuous-lead-time conditional diffusion for ensemble forecasting; correlated/fixed noise gives coherent trajectories. ARCI (24h autoregressive anchors + continuous interpolation): z500 day-10 RMSE 765.6 vs 811.8 (AR-6h), CRPS 355.2 vs 391.9; 8s vs 32s sampling. 3.5M-param U-Net, AdamW, 300 epochs. Transfer: coherent multi-horizon game-outcome trajectory ensembles.
papers.title: Continuous Ensemble Weather Forecasting with Diffusion Models

papers.key_result: Review chapter: non-centered TVP (beta_jt = beta_j + sqrt(theta_j)*tilde_beta_jt) converts variance selection to coefficient selection; shrinkage priors (triple gamma/horseshoe/spike-and-slab) with zero/fixed/dynamic classification. US inflation 1964Q1-2015Q4: treasury bills dynamic (P=0.86), commodity prices fixed (P=0.78), Dow zero (P=0.61). R package shrinkTVP. Transfer: sparse dynamic team-strength ratings.
papers.title: Sparse Bayesian State-Space and Time-Varying Parameter Models

papers.key_result: Arcsine laws for scoring dynamics across NBA/CFB/NFL/NHL (40,747 games, 1.3M events). Safe-lead formula Q(L,tau)=erf(L/sqrt(4D*tau)): 10-pt NBA lead 90% safe with 7.87 min left; max empirical overestimate 6.2%. NFL fit weakest (few discrete events). Transfer: parameter-light in-game WP baseline/feature.
papers.title: Safe Leads and Lead Changes in Competitive Team Sports

papers.key_result: Thematic analysis of ~12,000 r/Kalshi posts / 96,000 comments (66 annotated snippets): retail bettors confuse price/probability/payout/cash-out/liquidity/settlement source. Transfer: calibrated-uncertainty UI rules for GSE posts — label model vs market probability, show source/liquidity/resolution rules, pair charts with context.
papers.title: Prediction market visualizations, betting, and uncertainty: A study of Reddit Posts and Comments

papers.key_result: SPORTU benchmark: 900 text MCQs + 1,701 slow-motion clips / 12,048 QA pairs, 9 expert annotators. GPT-4o text 71.00%; video best Qwen2-VL-72B 70.94%, Claude 3.5 Sonnet 70.18%; rationale-first hurts (Claude 52.57% direct vs 39.32%); no model averages >3/5 open-ended G-Eval. Transfer: eval harness for GSE video/content models; direct-answer prompting.
papers.title: SPORTU: A Comprehensive Sports Understanding Benchmark for Multimodal Large Language Models

papers.key_result: DUPLICATE of ledger 1368 (already deep-read 2026-09-21, ADAPT). Kelly-OU: f*_t = R^{-1}c_t, one-asset f*=(mu_t-r)/sigma^2 with mean-reverting drift; 1% sigma-error ~= 2% drift-error. Replaced by 1500.
papers.title: Application of the Kelly Criterion to Ornstein-Uhlenbeck Processes

papers.key_result: ForecastBench-Sim: Freeciv simulated worlds, report at turn 60, hidden future turns 90-270 (H1-H7); 4,655 binary + 2,310 continuous questions; supports P(Y), P(Y|X), P(Y|do(X)). 30/31 models: Brier 0.220-0.313, CRPS 0.283-0.590; Spearman +0.43 vs real ForecastBench (p=0.018). Transfer: simulator-resolved calibration/counterfactual benchmark for GSE.
papers.title: ForecastBench-Sim: A Simulated-World Forecasting Benchmark

papers.key_result: FPL: per-player ARIMA + LSTM (40/60 blend) weekly forecasts into binary LP (100m budget, 2/5/5/3 formation); claimed 3,718-pt dream team, 87-pt season overforecast. Validation thin (no held-out, undisclosed LSTM, zero-filled absences). Transfer: forecast->ILP DFS pipeline under modern rolling-origin testing; distinct from 1091/1092 (they optimize given values, this forecasts them).
papers.title: Time Series Modeling for Dream Team in Fantasy Premier League

replacements.key_result: RACE/STAR: population performance envelope (GAMLSS C95) + per-athlete geometric transform (level alpha, timing gamma, tempo delta) in NLME; level-tempo correlation inside Sigma. MLB Statcast 2015-2021: sprint rho_hat=-0.80 (timing unidentified, near-linear envelope), bolt rho_hat=-0.84 (timing identified, curved envelope). Transfer: NFL aging curves relative to positional ceiling. Replaces REJECT 1464.
replacements.title: Modelling Athletic Ageing Relative to an Estimated Performance Envelope

replacements.key_result: H-scoring: dynamic draft value via per-pick gradient optimization of category weights + positional assignment on format win probability; learns soft punting implicitly. 20 simulated NBA seasons x 1,000 drafts: 21.8% Each-Category / 37.7% Most-Categories win rates vs 8.3% chance, beating static G-score. Transfer: adaptive fantasy/DFS draft strategy. Replaces duplicate 1462.
replacements.title: Dynamic quantification of player value for fantasy basketball

replacements.key_result: Assumption-free maximal Kelly growth rate = asymptotic inf-KL to the bipolar of the null class (Thm 3.5); KLinf identity restored under weak lower semicontinuity/compactness (Thm 4.1, Prop 4.5); composite-Q sequential GROW rate (Thm 6.5); test supermartingales suffice. Counterexample: KLinf>0 with achievable rate 0. Transfer: uncertainty-haircut on Kelly fraction from calibration-error class width. Replaces duplicate 1471.
replacements.title: The optimal betting wealth growth rate
